summary: Rizal 2nd District representative with about 76 principal-authored bills. Authored a revised Labor Code, estate tax amnesty, an anti-dynasty ban, a parallel manual count for automated elections and strengthening of the Anti-Money Laundering Council. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a broader anti-dynasty bill and a VAT exemption on discounts for military and police.
caveat: The Revised Labor Code contents were not reviewed, so the labor direction is uncertain. Bill-list evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored national minimum wage (-2) with an authored Revised Labor Code of unreviewed direction (0) gives a slight left lean on labor (-1); estate tax amnesty is direction-neutral (0). Two issues.
